label: Wipe instance
description: Remove everything one instance has: its triggers (wiped, runs cancelled), its copies of the infra nodes in `infra` (every disk, `keepOnTerminate` ones too), its `@instance_filled` values, connections, tokens, files and runs. Run it again to finish a wipe that stopped part way.

inputs.name: instance
inputs.description: The instance id your program gives it (`user-42`).

inputs.name: infra
inputs.description: The `@per_instance` infra nodes whose copy for this instance to delete. Copies of unlisted nodes are not touched.

inputs.name: includeSelf
inputs.label: Stop this run too
inputs.description: On: this run is cancelled too when it is one of the runs reached.

outputs.name: done
outputs.description: True once everything is removed except the infra copies, whose deletion is handed off and finishes afterwards.

then.message: WipeInstance '{id}' names {names} in `infra`, which is no infra node of this program marked `@per_instance`. Name each the way the program writes it (`bridge`, `work.bridge` inside a group, or `one.bridge` inside an included file).
